newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 20.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Nine Filipino colleagues of a Filipino designer who was found stabbed to death in his apartment in Khobar were detained for questioning, official says.
- Saudi Consolidated Electricity Company approves projects worth 600 million riyals in the Eastern Province.
- Britain's exports to Saudi Arabia rose 35 percent in 1996.
- Saudi-Egyptian committee plans to increase trade exchanges to 3.5 billion pounds.
